meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

copy.tagline: 切换 ultrawork 模式以遵循特定指令

copy.tagline_en: Switch to ultrawork mode to follow specific instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enable ultrawork mode on Codex

howto.what: 启用该模式后,Claude 会先声明模式开启,然后按强制流程:明确目标与成功标准,先写会失败的测试,再实现代码,并在真实环境亲自验证,同时把每个步骤记入笔记。
howto.when: 当你说出或输入“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发;触发后,它会把该模式的所有规则应用到这个任务上。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修复这个登录 bug。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试,再修复,并在真实环境验证。

say.text: 开启 ulw,实现一个 REST API 端点。
say.note: 它会按严格流程执行,包括多场景验证。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,重构这个模块。
say.note: 它会先分析影响,再证据驱动地完成。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude first announces the mode, then follows a strict workflow: define a goal with success criteria, write failing tests first, implement the code, and verify it in a real environment, recording every step in a notepad.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. Once triggered, it reads and follows all rules in the mode file for the rest of the task.

say_en.text: Fix this login bug in ultrawork mode.
Enable ulw and implement a REST API endpoint.
say_en.note: It follows the strict process including multi-scenario verification.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and refactor this module.
say_en.note: It analyzes impact first, then proceeds evidence-driven.
